title: Foundation
summary: IR contract (dt/ir.py), deterministic HTML renderer, Playwright bridge on system Chrome
Self-hosted Roboto + Material Symbols; Material Web 2.5 bundled for headless ground truth
Independent fidelity validator with three pass/fail tiers

title: Parallel build of the whole pipeline
summary: 9 modules built in parallel against the IR contract: perceive, compare, mapping, export, corpora, reference screens, refine, bench/tune, CLI
M3 catalog of 24 components derived from Material Web token files
Figma build plan + plugin, verified headlessly against a fake Figma API
Baseline bench on 24 ground-truth screens

title: Review fixes and render policy
summary: Kept reviewer fixes: tolerant export enums, stage-typo guard, comparable regression gate, region dedupe and split in segmentation
Rejected one reviewer OCR edit after the bench showed it cost 0.013 text recall
Single-line text never wraps in render or Figma export; pixel error fell from mean ΔE 2.04 to 1.85
Refine optimizer scores mutually exclusive edits from the same base and keeps the best
Font loading hardened: every used face is loaded and two frames pass before capture

title: Icon identification
summary: Atlas of all 4,299 Material Symbols in outlined and filled styles; shape match, then the renderer judges name, style, size and 1px offsets
Found and fixed a font mismatch: the static icon font equals the variable font at optical size 24, so the atlas and renderer now use opsz 24
60 common icons: 58 re-render identically; 120 random glyphs: 118
Matched box IoU 0.830 to 0.888; node precision +0.028; mean pixel ΔE 1.85 to 1.74

title: Fonts, line breaks and as-is fallback
summary: Stage attribution: renderer ceiling 0.989, mapping costs 0.151, perception 0.097; renderer floor traced to two ground-truth extraction bugs
Google Sans, Google Sans Text and Flex self-hosted; font family, size and weight chosen by rendering candidates (6 of 6 exact on a test page, page ΔE 2.61 to 0.015)
Text never wraps in render or Figma export; line breaks come from perception
Guarded as-is raster fallback for unexplained art; caught and blocked a degenerate win that covered text with crops; validator now reports rasterised area and text under crops
Bench: mean pixel ΔE 1.74 to 1.27, SSIM 0.941 to 0.966; Gmail mobile edges within 1px 59% to 76%

title: Round 3 merged: five parallel fixers
summary: Five fixers in isolated worktrees, each gated by tests and the bench, merged without conflicts
One variant vocabulary for corpus and matcher; Material Web host paint lifted; dialog moved onto its surface
Unpainted containers inferred (list items, lists, icon and text buttons, tabs, app bars, destinations): node recall 0.61 to 0.85
Per-line text and second-chance OCR for badges; hollow outlines; dialog scrims detected, un-blended and restacked
Metrics v2: geometry-fair matching, line-fair text, fidelity measures in the composite, regression gate shipped in knowledge/baseline.json
The round-2 pipeline scores 0.748 under metrics v2; the merged pipeline scores 0.890

title: Skeptic pass: eight adversarial reviewers
summary: Eight isolated reviewers tried to break the merged pipeline: 64 bugs found, 50 fixed with failing-first tests, all verdicts usable-with-gaps
Closed metric-gaming holes: a 48x48 render or a full-page screenshot used to pass every gate; validation now judges on the target frame and gates rasters and text-as-pixels
Raster fallback could still bake a 20px headline into a crop and overrun its budget in batches; fixed and made deterministic
Linux installs were impossible (pyobjc); now installable with RapidOCR, Chromium fallback, setup script and dt doctor
Ground truth: text boxes are line boxes, menus paint on top, corpus pages use relative paths
Export round-trip checker added; filled icons, local images and auto-layout drift fixed
MCP server runs tools on one worker thread; renderer keeps one browser per thread
